post_title: What will Samolet's BO-P16 bond close at on 13 November 2026, as a percentage of par?

question.title: What will Samolet's BO-P16 bond close at on 13 November 2026, as a percentage of par?
question.description:
ПАО «ГК «Самолет» is one of Russia's largest residential developers and has been in severe financial distress through 2026, hit by high interest rates, weakening new-home demand and a heavy debt load. The company has sought large-scale support from state banks (reports put the request at roughly RUB 50 bn), has suffered credit-rating downgrades, and its bonds trade far below par.

Payment record in 2026: coupons on two series were paid late in May 2026; on 28 September 2026, only RUB 269.10 per RUB 1,000 of par was delivered on the redemption date of series БО-П20 (RU000A10CZA1), with the remainder credited the next day, and the National Settlement Depository (NSD) marked that redemption as "improper performance" (ненадлежащее исполнение) — https://nsddata.ru/ru/news/view/1449326 . Since then, October payments have been made on schedule: БО-П16 coupon of RUB 20.96 on 14 October, БО-П18 coupon of RUB 19.73 on 20 October, БО-П13 coupon of RUB 17.26 on 26 October, and redemption of series 01 (RU000A0JWYJ0, RUB 1.5 bn) on 30 October 2026.

On 28 October 2026 the main creditor banks (Sberbank, VTB) agreed a comprehensive programme to restore the company's financial health, which is still to be finalised; Sberbank said its provisions were adequate and that it does not plan to take equity in the developer — https://www.interfax-russia.ru/realty/news/osnovnye-kreditory-samoleta-soglasovali-plan-uluchsheniya-ego-sostoyaniya-sber . On 30 October, reports said VTB intends to take part in a "sanation" of Samolet via debt restructuring. How bondholders would be treated in any such restructuring — including possible haircuts or maturity extensions — is unresolved, and is the main driver of the deep discounts on Samolet paper.

The bond in question: БО-П16 (ISIN RU000A10BFX7), a RUB 3 bn issue placed 22 April 2025, with 36 monthly coupons at a fixed 25.5% (RUB 20.96 per bond), no amortisation, maturing 6 April 2028. Its next coupon, of about RUB 63 m in aggregate, falls due on 13 November 2026 — the resolution date of this question — so the closing price that day also reflects the market's view of whether that payment is being honoured (coupon schedule: https://bonds.finam.ru/issue/details040A000002/default.asp ).

Market levels as of today (30 October 2026): БО-П16 closed at 60.05% of par, down from 66.46% a day earlier, with about 1,900 trades on the day and an effective yield near 99%. Other Samolet series sit at similar discounts — БО-П13 (maturing 24 January 2027) near 77%, БО-П18 around 54-57%, БО-П21 around 52% — with the largest single wall, the RUB 24.5 bn БО-П13 maturity, falling due in January 2027. Because the bond is actively traded and the exchange publishes a daily closing price for it (the CLOSE field used here, i.e. the last trade price of the session), its 13 November 2026 closing price is a clean, single-number measure of how the market assesses Samolet's default and restructuring risk that week.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the Moscow Exchange closing price of ПАО «ГК «Самолет» exchange-traded bonds series БО-П16 (ISIN RU000A10BFX7) on the main bond board (TQCB) on 13 November 2026, expressed in percent of nominal value (par). The value is the CLOSE field for TRADEDATE 2026-11-13 in the Moscow Exchange ISS history data: https://iss.moex.com/iss/history/engines/stock/markets/bonds/boards/TQCB/securities/RU000A10BFX7.json?from=2026-11-13&till=2026-11-13 (for example, a CLOSE value of 60.05 means the question resolves to 60.05). If the bond does not trade on 13 November 2026 (including because of a trading halt or suspension), the CLOSE value from the most recent trading day before that date on the same board is used.
